title: CSV import fails or silently mangles common spreadsheet exports (duplicate headers, renamed columns, truncated rows)
existing_state: CsvManager.LoadFromFile discards the user's first header name entirely and replaces it with Host_IP with no notice (Services/CsvManager.cs:32-35), silently rewrites spaces to underscores in remaining headers (CsvManager.cs:45) — which changes the {{column_name}} variable names scripts reference — and silently truncates any row longer than the header (CsvManager.cs:61-62). Duplicate header names (extremely common in Excel exports) crash the load: dt.Columns.Add(headerName) at CsvManager.cs:46 throws DuplicateNameException, and Form1.OpenCsvFile surfaces the raw framework message "Failed to load CSV: A column named 'X' already belongs to this DataTable" (Form1.cs:9239-9242). There is no delimiter detection (semicolon-delimited locale exports parse as one column) and no encoding handling beyond BOM strip, so Windows-1252 Excel exports load with mojibake.
recommendation: Make LoadFromFile resilient and the import transparent: (1) dedupe duplicate headers by suffixing (Name, Name_2, ...) instead of throwing; (2) sniff the delimiter from the header line (comma vs semicolon vs tab) and detect encoding via StreamReader with detectEncodingFromByteOrderMarks plus a Windows-1252 fallback heuristic; (3) return an import summary (rows loaded, columns renamed, rows truncated, first-column-renamed-to-Host_IP) and show it once in a non-modal banner or expandable status line in Form1.OpenCsvFile instead of staying silent; (4) warn when the original first header was something like "name" or "site" that does not look host-like, since every row will then target the wrong "host".
user_benefit: Operators feed this grid from spreadsheets exported by other teams; today a duplicate column kills the import with a cryptic error, and a wrong-first-column file silently targets 200 wrong hosts. Robust import with a visible summary removes the most common first-five-minutes failure for new users.

evidence.note: first header discarded, spaces->underscores, duplicate Columns.Add throws

raw exception message shown as the only feedback
